title: FortiGate Homelab License: What Works Without a Contract
excerpt: What a used FortiGate still does with no FortiCare contract, why Fortinet refuses most secondhand transfers, and the exact limits of the free FortiGate-VM trial.
serp: Exploring Virtual Network Security: Setting up Secure Home Lab Setup with Fortigate FortiOS!
Can i Use Fortigate Without License? - SPOTO Official Blog
FortiGate Home Lab on a Budget

claims.claim: A FortiGate keeps working as a firewall when any or all FortiGuard licenses have expired.
claims.quote: The FortiGate will still function as a firewall if any or all of the FortiGuard licenses are expired.

claims.claim: With an expired IPS license, IPS keeps scanning with the existing signatures but gets no new ones.
claims.quote: IPS scanning continues to work, but the IPS databases are not updated and no new signatures are added.

claims.claim: With an expired antivirus license, antivirus keeps scanning with the last database.
claims.quote: Antivirus scanning continues to work, but the antivirus database is not updated and no new signatures are added.

claims.claim: Application control, Internet Service Database and device/OS identification keep working but frozen, and they come with all FortiCare support contracts.
claims.quote: are included in the base services that are included with all FortiCare support contracts

claims.claim: Category-based web and DNS filtering stops when the license lapses, because lookups are real-time.
claims.quote: Category-based Web and DNS filtering stops working, as URLs and domains are sent to FortiGuard in real-time to determine the category.

claims.claim: By default, all web and DNS traffic is dropped when web/DNS filtering cannot rate requests.
claims.quote: By default, all web and DNS traffic is dropped.

claims.claim: Static URL or domain filters keep working without a license.
claims.quote: If static URL or domain filtering is applied in a filter profile, those filters continue to work.

claims.claim: Antispam stops working without a license because it uses real-time queries.
claims.quote: Spam filtering stops working, as it queries the FortiGuard spam filtering server in real-time

claims.claim: Outbreak prevention stops working without a license because it uses real-time lookups.
claims.quote: Outbreak prevention stops working, as it uses real-time lookups to the FortiGuard Global Threat Intelligence database.

claims.claim: IPsec, QoS, VLANs and dynamic routing such as OSPF and BGP work out of the box without a subscription.
claims.quote: QOS, static and dynamic (OSPF, BGP, etc.) routing, VLANs, and such will work out of the box.

claims.claim: SD-WAN can be enabled on all FortiGate models at no additional cost.
claims.quote: No, SD-WAN can be enabled on all FortiGate models at no additional cost.

claims.claim: The 60F datasheet marks application control as included with FortiCare.
claims.quote: Application Control --------------included with FortiCare Subscription--------------

claims.claim: A FortiGate must be registered before it shows its FortiGuard licenses.
claims.quote: It is necessary to register the FortiGate before it can show the FortiGuard licenses.

claims.claim: diagnose autoupdate versions prints a Contract Expiry Date and Last Updated line per package (example output used in the article).
claims.quote: Contract Expiry Date: Fri Jan 21 2022 Last Updated using scheduled update on Sun Apr 25 07:21:32 2021

claims.claim: Firmware downloads from FortiCloud require a registered product with an active support contract.
claims.quote: Firmware image downloads are available only for registered products with an active support contract.

claims.claim: On FortiOS 7.4.2 and later, upgrade enforcement compares the firmware license expiry with the first GA release date of the target major or minor version.
claims.quote: enforcement is based on the expiry date of the current firmware license compared to the release date of the first GA release of a major or minor version.

claims.claim: Upgrades by GUI file upload are blocked when the contract expired before the target's .0 GA release.
claims.quote: If the contract is expired relative to the major firmware GA .0 version release date, the following upgrade attempt will be blocked in the GUI

claims.claim: A blocked TFTP upgrade in Fortinet's example ends with return code -180.
claims.quote: Command fail. Return code -180

claims.claim: Downgrades between major or minor versions are not blocked.
claims.quote: Downgrades from one major or minor version to another are not blocked

claims.claim: diagnose test update info contract | grep FMWR shows the FMWR (firmware) contract expiry.
claims.quote: by using the diagnose test update info contract | grep FMWR command

claims.claim: A FortiGate with no FMWR license information, as on an EVAL license, cannot upgrade firmware.
claims.quote: In the special scenario where the FMWR license information is missing, the FortiGate will not be allowed to upgrade. This scenario may occur when running on an EVAL license

claims.claim: Since FortiOS 7.4.9 and 7.6.4, FortiGates with an invalid FMWR license must upgrade to the latest patch within their minor version.
claims.quote: Since FortiOS 7.4.9 and 7.6.4, FortiGates are required to upgrade to the latest patch within their current minor version when:

claims.claim: Required upgrades can be postponed in fixed 7-day steps but not canceled.
claims.quote: Use the execute auto-upgrade delay-installation command to postpone the installation for a fixed 7-day period.

claims.claim: The ForcedUpdate flag tells FortiGuard to skip the license check for same-minor upgrades.
claims.quote: The ForcedUpdate flag instructs FortiGuard server to ignore the license check for the device and parse its firmware version.

claims.claim: The 8.0 new features page gives 7.4.8 (not 7.4.9) as the starting version for required upgrades.
claims.quote: Since FortiOS 7.4.8 and 7.6.4, FortiGates are required to upgrade to the latest patch when:

claims.claim: The 7.6.4 guide warned that required upgrades may fail because FDS blocks the download.
claims.quote: the required upgrade may fail where the firmware download is blocked by FDS

claims.claim: FG-IR-24-015 is an out-of-bounds write in sslvpnd with a CVSSv3 score of 9.6.
claims.quote: Out-of-bound Write in sslvpnd

claims.claim: FG-IR-24-015 is fixed in FortiOS 7.4.3 and 7.2.7.
claims.quote: FortiOS 7.4.3 or above FortiOS 7.2.7 or above

claims.claim: CISA added CVE-2024-21762 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (release date February 9, 2024).
claims.quote: CISA has added one new vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog, based on evidence of active exploitation.

claims.claim: FortiOS 7.6.0 removed SSL VPN web and tunnel mode from models with 2 GB of RAM or less, without upgrading settings.
claims.quote: On FortiGate models with 2GB of RAM or below, the SSL VPN web and tunnel mode feature will no longer be available from the GUI or CLI.

claims.claim: The 7.6.0 SSL VPN removal covers the 40F and variants, 60F, 61F and FortiGate Rugged 60F.
claims.quote: FGT-40F/FWF-40F and variants FGT-60F/FWF-60F FGT-61F/FWF-61F FGR-60F and variants (2GB and 4GB versions)

claims.claim: The 60F datasheet footnotes that SSL VPN is not supported on FortiOS 7.6.0 and above.
claims.quote: SSL VPN not supported on FortiOS 7.6.0 and above.

claims.claim: FortiOS 7.6.3 replaced SSL VPN tunnel mode with IPsec on all models.
claims.quote: Starting in FortiOS 7.6.3, the SSL VPN tunnel mode feature is replaced with IPsec VPN, which can be configured to use TCP port 443.

claims.claim: Agentless VPN (former SSL VPN web mode) is unavailable on the 40F, 50G, 60F, 61F, 70G, 90G and 91G.
claims.quote: FGT-40F/FWF-40F and variants FGT-50G/FWF-50G and variants FGT-60F/FWF-60F FGT-61F/FWF-61F FGR-60F and variants (2GB versions only) FGT-70G/FWF-70G and variants FGT-90G and FGT-91G

claims.claim: diagnose hardware sysinfo conserve showing total RAM below 2000 MB identifies a 2 GB model.
claims.quote: check that the total RAM value is below 2000 MB (1000 MB = 1 GB).

claims.claim: From FortiOS 7.4.4, 2 GB models no longer support proxy-related features.
claims.quote: starting from version 7.4.4, FortiOS no longer supports proxy-related features.

claims.claim: After upgrading, proxy-based inspection on a policy is converted to flow mode on 2 GB models.
claims.quote: Inspection mode is converted to flow mode.

claims.claim: IPsec over TCP is supported from FortiGate 7.4.2 and FortiClient 7.4.1.
claims.quote: Configuring TCP as transport is supported on FortiGate firmware version 7.4.2 and later.

claims.claim: FortiClient TCP transport for IPsec requires FortiClient 7.4.1 or later.
claims.quote: supported in FortiClient version 7.4.1 and later

claims.claim: TCP 443 transport suits networks where UDP 500 and 4500 are blocked.
claims.quote: ideal for environments where traditional IPsec traffic on UDP/500 and UDP/4500 is blocked

claims.claim: RFC 9329 standardizes TCP encapsulation of IKE and IPsec.
claims.quote: This document describes a method to transport Internet Key Exchange Protocol (IKE) and IPsec packets over a TCP connection

claims.claim: The FortiCloud registration wizard asks for the partner or reseller.
claims.quote: Specify the Fortinet Partner or Reseller that helped you with your asset.

claims.claim: Unit transfers need written approval from both the current and new account admins.
claims.quote: To complete the registration transfer, the Fortinet customer service team needs written consent/approval from Org A and Org B.

claims.claim: Customer Service makes three email attempts and a phone call; transfers typically take 4 to 5 business days.
claims.quote: the ticket would typically take 4 to 5 business days to resolve depending on the ticket scenario.

claims.claim: Transfers are denied for units bought through unauthorized sales such as eBay, gray market, or secondhand/auction sales.
claims.quote: If the unit is purchased through unauthorized sales (e.g. eBay, Grey Market, Second hand/auction sale, or any other e-commerce platform).

claims.claim: Transfers between generic accounts such as Gmail are denied.
claims.quote: Generic to Generic account transfers. (Gmail, Hotmail, Yahoo, Outlook, etc.)

claims.claim: The self-serve Asset Transfer token is for intercompany transfers only, not third-party transfers.
claims.quote: The 'Asset Transfer' token tool is intended solely for Intercompany transfers

claims.claim: The Asset Transfer token does not apply to third-party transfers.
claims.quote: not applicable for third-party transfers

claims.claim: The FortiOS GUI transfer requires the current FortiCloud account's username and password.
claims.quote: enter the username and password for the current account.

claims.claim: Since FortiOS 7.2.1, a FortiGate registered three or more years can be deregistered from the GUI or CLI.
claims.quote: An administrator can deregister a FortiGate, if the device has been registered for three or more years, using the GUI or CLI

claims.claim: Deregistering a FortiGate also deregisters its contracts.
claims.quote: After the device is deregistered, all associated contracts are also deregistered

claims.claim: Deregistration within three years fails with 'Unit deregistration unsuccessful.'
claims.quote: Unit deregistration unsuccessful.

claims.claim: Deregistration CLI command.
claims.quote: diagnose forticare direct-registration product-deregister <accountID> <password>

claims.claim: In the portal, a decommissioned unit can then be deregistered.
claims.quote: When a hardware device is moved to Decommissioned Units you can deregister the unit to purge it from your account.

claims.claim: Fortinet's service terms define a customer as someone who bought from an authorized FortiPartner or Fortinet.
claims.quote: purchased a Product or Service Contract from an authorized FortiPartner or Fortinet

claims.claim: Fortinet may terminate service contracts if the unit is transferred to a third party.
claims.quote: (c) transfer of the unit of Product to a third party

claims.claim: Renewals start the day after the previous contract expired.
claims.quote: the effective date of any Renewal Service Contract shall begin the next calendar day following the expiration date of the previous Service Contract.

claims.claim: If a renewal is registered more than 180 days after expiry, it is backdated to 180 days before registration.
claims.quote: such Renewal Service Contract effective start date will be the date that is one hundred eighty (180) calendar days prior to the actual Registration Date

claims.claim: FortiOS 7.2.1 introduced the permanent FortiGate-VM evaluation license, replacing the 15-day evaluation.
claims.quote: A permanent evaluation VM license replaces the 15 day evaluation period for FortiGate-VM.

claims.claim: The evaluation VM license applies to private clouds such as VMware ESXi and KVM.
claims.quote: The evaluation VM license applies to all private cloud (VMware ESXi, KVM, and so on)

claims.claim: The permanent trial is limited to 1 CPU and 2 GB of memory.
claims.quote: Maximum of 1 CPU and 2 GB of memory

claims.claim: The permanent trial is limited to three interfaces, three firewall policies and three routes.
claims.quote: Maximum of three interfaces, firewall policies, and routes

claims.claim: The permanent trial supports two VDOMs, with root as the admin type.
claims.quote: Support for a maximum of two virtual domains (VDOM). When using multi-VDOM mode, the root VDOM must be an admin type

claims.claim: The permanent trial supports low encryption only, except GUI management and FortiManager.
claims.quote: Support for low encryption operation only, except for GUI management access and FortiManager communications

claims.claim: The permanent trial has no FortiCare or FortiGuard support.
claims.quote: No FortiCare support No FortiGuard support

claims.claim: One free evaluation copy per FortiCloud account.
claims.quote: Maximum of one free evaluation copy per FortiCloud account

claims.claim: The trial license does not expire.
claims.quote: This VM is using the evaluation license. This license does not expire.

claims.claim: Activation commands for the trial license.
claims.quote: execute vm-license-options account-id xxxx@fortinet.com execute vm-license-options account-password xxxxxxx execute vm-license

claims.claim: Expected status after activation.
claims.quote: License Status: Valid VM Resources: 1 CPU/1 allowed, 2007 MB RAM/2048 MB allowed

claims.claim: Low encryption models use only 56-bit DES for IPsec and Agentless VPN and cannot perform SSL inspection.
claims.quote: LENC models only use 56-bit DES encryption to work with Agentless VPN and IPsec VPN, and they are unable to perform SSL inspection.

claims.claim: Testing of the older evaluation license found only DES enabled.
claims.quote: means only DES is enabled as algorithm.

claims.claim: RFC 8247 says DES provides no meaningful security and must not be implemented for IKEv2.
claims.quote: ENCR_DES can be brute-forced using off-the-shelf hardware. It provides no meaningful security whatsoever and, therefore, MUST NOT be implemented.

claims.claim: Owner report: a redeployed trial VM showed an invalid license; staff pointed to Customer Service removing the old registration.
claims.quote: you may contact the customer support team to remove the registered unit and use the new one.

claims.claim: The older 15-day evaluation license applies to FortiOS 7.2.0.
claims.quote: FortiOS 7.2.0 supports the older evaluation license, which has a 15-day term.

claims.claim: When the 15-day trial expires, FortiOS disables functionality until a full license is uploaded.
claims.quote: After the trial license expires, FortiOS disables functionality until you upload a full license file.

claims.claim: All self-paced Fortinet Training Institute lessons are free; on-demand labs are not included.
claims.quote: are open free of charge. On-demand labs are not included.

claims.claim: The FortiGate Administrator course is based on FortiOS 7.4.1.
claims.quote: FortiOS 7.4.1

claims.claim: The course estimates 12 hours of lecture and 10 hours of lab.
claims.quote: Lecture time (estimated): 12 hours Lab time (estimated): 10 hours

claims.claim: All FortiGuard bundles include FortiCare Premium.
claims.quote: All bundles include FortiCare Premium Services featuring 24x7x365 availability

claims.claim: Bundle names on the 60F datasheet.
claims.quote: Enterprise Protection Unified Threat Protection Advanced Threat Protection

claims.claim: 'Allow websites when a rating error occurs' is disabled by default.
claims.quote: The setting is disabled by default in the default Web Filter profile and while creating a new Web Filter profile.

claims.claim: The error-allow option lets pages with a rating error pass.
claims.quote: Allow web pages with a rating error to pass through.

claims.claim: set options under ftgd-wf takes a list of options.
claims.quote: set options {option1}, {option2}, ...

claims.claim: FortiOS 7.6.1 changed the default IKE TCP port to 443 on new deployments.
claims.quote: In FortiOS version 7.6.1, the default IKE TCP port has been changed to port 443 on new deployments.

claims.claim: Fix for the GUI and IKE TCP port collision.
claims.quote: set admin-sport <port> end Customize the ike-tcp-port to a value other than 443:

claims.claim: Wrong system time breaks certificate-based IPsec.
claims.quote: Certificate-based IPsec VPN will fail if the system time is outside the certificate's validation window.

claims.claim: Wrong time can make license validation fail and stall FortiGuard updates.
claims.quote: License validation may temporarily fail. Services like Web-filtering, antivirus, IPS, and applications may not update correctly.

claims.claim: A faulty battery can cause NTP sync problems.
claims.quote: A faulty battery can cause hardware to be out of NTP sync.

claims.claim: Custom NTP server configuration.
claims.quote: config system ntp set type custom config ntpserver edit 1 set server pool.ntp.org

claims.claim: Expected output of diagnose sys ntp status when synced.
claims.quote: synchronized: yes, ntpsync: enabled, server-mode: disabled

claims.claim: FG-IR-24-015 has a CVSSv3 score of 9.6.
claims.quote: CVSSv3 Score 9.6

claims.claim: CISA's alert adding CVE-2024-21762 was released February 9, 2024.
claims.quote: Release Date February 09, 2024

claims.claim: CISA's KEV entry names CVE-2024-21762 Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability.
claims.quote: CVE-2024-21762 Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability

claims.claim: Customer Service makes three email attempts and a phone call to both admins.
claims.quote: The customer service team needs to make mandatory 3 email attempts and a phone call to Org A and Org B

claims.claim: GUI deregistration arrived in FortiOS 7.2.1.
claims.quote: Deregistration from the GUI 7.2.1

claims.claim: FortiOS 7.2.1 introduced the permanent trial license, which requires a FortiCloud account.
claims.quote: FortiOS 7.2.1 introduces a new permanent trial license, which requires a FortiCloud account.

claims.claim: On 2 GB models from 7.4.4, proxy inspection modes and explicit/transparent proxies are unsupported.
claims.quote: UTM profile with proxy-based inspection mode Firewall policy with proxy-based inspection mode Explicit and transparent proxies

claims.claim: Video filter, inline CASB and WAF are among the removed proxy-only features on 2 GB models.
claims.quote: Video Filter Inline CASB ICAP Web application firewall (WAF)

claims.claim: ZTNA is among the proxy features removed on 2 GB models.
claims.quote: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)

claims.claim: The IKE TCP port change can break GUI access when the admin port is also 443.
claims.quote: This may affect GUI access for interfaces bound to an IPsec tunnel in the scenario that the GUI admin port is also using port 443.

claims.claim: Required upgrades cannot be canceled once scheduled.
claims.quote: You cannot cancel required upgrades after they are scheduled

claims.claim: Agentless VPN continues on models not listed.
claims.quote: FortiGate models not listed above will continue to support Agentless VPN (formerly SSL VPN web mode).

claims.claim: The 7.6.3 tunnel mode replacement applies to all FortiGate models and settings are not upgraded.
claims.quote: Settings will not be upgraded from previous versions. This applies to all FortiGate models.

claims.claim: The 7.6.0 removal does not upgrade SSL VPN settings.
claims.quote: Settings will not be upgraded from previous versions.

claims.claim: Registration starts from Products, Register More.
claims.quote: Go to Products and click the Register More button.

claims.claim: Base services included with FortiCare on the 60F datasheet.
claims.quote: Device/OS Detection, GeoIPs, Trusted CA Certificates, Internet Services and Botnet IPs, DDNS (v4/v6), Local Protection, PSIRT Check, Anti-Phishing

claims.claim: An active support contract gives access to firmware upgrades and downgrades.
claims.quote: Maintaining an active support contract for your FortiGate allows you to access the latest firmware upgrades and downgrades

claims.claim: Signature updates and real-time lookups require valid FortiGuard licenses.
claims.quote: Valid FortiGuard licenses are required to receive database and signature updates, and to perform real-time or near-real-time security lookups

claims.claim: Renewal lapses are backdated up to 6 months (secondary source corroborating the 180-day rule).
claims.quote: And so forth, up to 6 months back.

claims.claim: The trial activation reboots the VM.
claims.quote: This operation will reboot the system !
